input: Clarify an existing workflow paragraph without changing its rule.
acceptance: Diff review confirms the same rule and a clearer sentence.
boundary: Clear documentation change with direct review.

input: Add one specified routing boundary case to a local rule.
constraints: No new command or provider lookup.
acceptance: Focused behavior test and unified verification pass.
boundary: Small code change with an explicit specification.

input: Extend a Workshop behavior while preserving its existing modes.
acceptance: AUTO, FORCE and BYPASS behavior tests pass.
boundary: Routine feature spanning a module and its tests.

input: Turn an ambiguous product request into a bounded brief.
constraints: Keep blocking unknowns and user decisions explicit.
acceptance: Brief identifies goal, options, unresolved questions and verification.

input: Synthesize existing contract evidence into a decision note.
constraints: Separate evidence, inference and open questions; no new external lookup in this fixture.
acceptance: Every material claim has a recoverable source reference.

input: Move a shared routing rule across module, reference and tests.
constraints: Preserve public contracts and old caller behavior.
acceptance: Affected tests and unified verification pass; diff has no unrelated edits.
boundary: Cross-file change with coupling and compatibility.

input: Investigate a state restoration regression with repeatable evidence.
constraints: Do not erase a valid regression test or reset user state.
acceptance: Failing case reproduced before fix and then passes without weaker assertions.

input: Check a transition that binds Packet approval to the current revision.
constraints: Keep seven states, schema 2 and trusted approval checks.
acceptance: Unauthorized and stale Packet paths fail; valid transition passes.

input: Recover an interrupted migrated project from recorded state.
constraints: Do not repeat completed side effects or invent approvals.
acceptance: Recovery resumes from the confirmed boundary and rejects stale evidence.

input: Review whether a proposed extension changes governance authority.
constraints: Identify open tradeoffs; do not implement or approve a release.
acceptance: Review traces each concern to contract and acceptance impact.

input: Choose whether a clear task enters Workshop discovery.
constraints: Honor explicit FORCE/BYPASS and keep the fast path small.
acceptance: Clear request proceeds directly; ambiguous request surfaces a blocking unknown.

input: Route a simple but high-impact change with separate risk and ability signals.
constraints: Review rigor cannot silently raise capability tier or grant authority.
acceptance: Risk controls apply while capability recommendation follows task cognition.

input: A local tool returns permission denied before work starts.
constraints: No model call or tier escalation.
acceptance: Attribution is environment-related and plan stops.
boundary: Tool failure must not masquerade as capability failure.

input: Repeated evidenced capability failure reaches the top ordinary candidate.
constraints: FRONTIER requires explicit sparse approval and separate capability evidence.
acceptance: Without approval the plan stops; fixture with approval yields only a proposal.
boundary: FRONTIER sparse gate without a live call.

input: One lower-capability candidate succeeds on a representative task.
constraints: Do not infer global overroute from one success.
acceptance: Outcome remains insufficient evidence absent repeated comparable results.

input: A result has no host usage counters or execution clock.
constraints: No synthetic token or time estimate.
acceptance: Usage and time remain null or unknown.
